name: Paneer Bhurji Wrap
ingredients: ¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp coriander powder
2 whole-wheat rotis or wraps (about 60 g each)
Coriander, salt and a squeeze of lemon
Sliced cucumber and mint chutney, to serve
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion and chilli for 4 minutes.
Add the tomato and spices and cook for 4 minutes until pulpy.
Add the paneer and 2 tbsp water and cook for 3 minutes. Add salt, lemon and coriander.
Warm the rotis. Spread with chutney, fill with bhurji and cucumber, and roll tightly.
note: A portable high-protein meal; the whole-wheat wrap adds fibre.
